organization.name_ja: 株式会社インターネットイニシアティブ（IIJ）

affected.note: Accounts of the corporate email security service IIJ Secure MX. The first notice (2025-04-15) said up to 4,072,650 email accounts across 6,493 contracts (all customers) might be affected. The 2025-04-22 investigation confirmed leakage for 586 contracts: account IDs/passwords for 132 contracts (311,288 of the email accounts), email bodies/headers for 6 contracts, and credentials for linked third-party cloud services for 488 contracts. The attacker exploited a then-unknown vulnerability in the third-party Active! mail software.

summary.en: IIJ found on 2025-04-10 that equipment for its corporate email security service IIJ Secure MX had been accessed without authorization since 2024-08-03 via a zero-day flaw in Active! mail. Its follow-up report confirmed that 311,288 email account credentials, plus email contents and cloud service credentials for some contracts, had leaked.
summary.ja: IIJは2025年4月10日、法人向けメールセキュリティサービス「IIJセキュアMXサービス」の設備が、Active! mailの未知の脆弱性を突かれて2024年8月3日以降不正アクセスを受けていたことを確認した。続報で、311,288件のメールアカウント・パスワードと、一部契約のメール本文や連携クラウドサービスの認証情報の漏えいを確認したと公表した。
